subject: Dwight Hall Weekly: Night Market, Harvard-Yale Donation Drive
text:
DWIGHT HALL WEEKLY

AT DWIGHT HALL THIS WEEKEND
The Asian American Students Alliance Night Market takes over Dwight Hall and the courtyard on Sun 11/8 from 7 to 10pm. Proceeds benefit a local charity.

HARVARD-YALE DONATION DRIVE (with YCC)
Nov 1-20. Drop off warm clothing and non-perishable food at Dwight Hall or Silliman College for the Women of the Village Food Pantry.

Dwight Hall at Yale
